acceptanceClarifications.scope: Rebuilt from pinned replacement ESPN/SportsDataverse events. The original historical raw file remains unavailable.
Real pre-shot margins and a proposed-shot input contract. Before-possession forecasting remains SCRUM-641/BST-117.

risks.comment:
The shot dataset can now be rebuilt from six pinned ESPN/SportsDataverse files with recorded hashes. The original historical raw file is still unavailable, so this is a replacement source. Keep the pinned files and recovery instructions with each release.

[Source record](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/b2076f2/docs/iteration-17/shot-repair/source-manifest.json)

The data-check report and dataset metadata are now available. They show each source's version, seasons and row count; the old Synergy pull date stays unrecorded. This makes coverage changes visible, but it does not establish that seasons have the same distribution.

[Dataset checks](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/b2076f2/docs/iteration-17/verification/live-api-final/dataset-catalog.json)

The rebuilt shot data now has saved fold results and a separate later-season comparison. Those results evaluate a supplied shot type and location. Forecasting before a possession is still open in SCRUM-641, with BST-117 still failed.

[Evaluation](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/b2076f2/docs/iteration-17/shot-repair/model-evaluation.json) · [SCRUM-641](https://basketball-strategy.atlassian.net/browse/SCRUM-641)

Shot Statistical Analysis now renders the current response. The shot pages also clear old results when filters change, and the heatmap shows attempt counts and exclusions. Keep the stakeholder review open to check whether the presentation is easy to use.

[Browser checks](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/b2076f2/docs/iteration-17/verification/shot-flow-recheck/browser/checks.json)

Readiness now checks required data and configuration separately from liveness. Missing components return 503 with a clear reason, and the deployed configured service passed /ready. Keep the clean-checkout and recovery checks in the release process.

[Readiness checks](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/b2076f2/docs/iteration-17/verification/live-api-final/results.json)

SCRUM-640 is finished: the main results appear first and the extra detail is expandable. The saved shot-metrics CSV was also verified. The three-scenario follow-up with Navreet is still needed before this review is complete.

[Screen checks](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/b2076f2/docs/iteration-17/verification/browser/browser-checks.json) · [CSV check](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/b2076f2/docs/iteration-17/verification/browser/shot-metrics-csv-check.json)
